description: The unchanged 100 core acceptance points plus eight explicit research-derived checkpoints. Research completion itself earns no implementation points.

supplemental.name: 3D scene geometry and lighting
supplemental.basic: Render original planes with camera projection, depth ordering and declared light behavior against independent geometry/pixel references
supplemental.extended: Validate clipping, hierarchy, camera/light animation and unsupported material or shadow diagnostics

supplemental.name: Motion blur and temporal integration
supplemental.basic: Render declared shutter angle, phase and bounded temporal samples against an independent time-integration fixture
supplemental.extended: Verify animated boundaries, subframe offsets, convergence and explicit effect-specific temporal limitations

supplemental.name: Typed property expressions and links
supplemental.basic: Evaluate bounded time-driven expressions and property links deterministically without arbitrary code or network execution
supplemental.extended: Reject cycles and invalid types; validate shuffled-time evaluation, seeded operations, limits and reproducibility

supplemental.name: Local foreground segmentation
supplemental.basic: Accept original annotations and produce editable versioned masks through an optional local tool with explicit provenance
supplemental.extended: Verify edge and temporal quality, fresh offline execution, repeatability, model identity and unsupported automation diagnostics
